# Matter Atlas

[Explore the 3D periodic table](https://hallojoe.github.io/periodic-table/)

![The Matter Atlas periodic table with the element inspector](https://hallojoe.github.io/periodic-table/screenshots/lattice.png)

Orbit 118 element boxes, select one to enter its room, or search by symbol, name or atomic number. Inside each element, explore its Bohr model, physical properties and discovery history. Enable the theoretical layer for elements 119 and 120.
